title: C-Unseen: Weak Signal Detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs via LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.26870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weak signals are early, low-visibility indicators that precede significant changes before those changes become established. Existing detection methods, based on keyword frequency, topic modeling, or untyped graph topology, fail to capture the semantic and relational structure through which such signals manifest. In this paper, we propose C-Unseen, a self-interpretable framework for weak signal detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs (DTKGs). We define a weak signal as a rare, semantically coherent subgraph that proliferates across consecutive TKG snapshots. The framework operates through two modules: a Rare Subgraphs Extractor, in which an LLM identifies subgraphs whose content is in tension with the dominant snapshot narrative via chain-of-thought reasoning, and a Weak Signal Alerter, in which the persistence of these rare subgraphs is tracked across time steps to isolate true weak signals. translated_title: C-Unseen：基于大语言模型推理的动态时序知识图谱弱信号检测
translated_abstract: 弱信号是在重大变化确立之前出现的早期、低可见性指标。现有的检测方法基于关键词频率、主题建模或非类型化图拓扑，未能捕捉这些信号所体现的语义和关系结构。在本文中，我们提出C-Unseen，一个用于动态时序知识图谱（DTKGs）中弱信号检测的自解释框架。我们将弱信号定义为在连续TKG快照中增殖的罕见、语义连贯的子图。该框架通过两个模块运作：罕见子图提取器，其中大语言模型通过链式思维推理识别与主导快照叙事内容相冲突的子图；以及弱信号警报器，其中跨时间步追踪这些罕见子图的持续性以隔离真正的弱信号。实验结果表明，C-Unseen在检测动态时序知识图谱中的弱信号方面表现出色。
tldr: C-Unseen利用大语言模型推理和链式思维，通过识别并追踪罕见语义连贯子图在动态时序知识图谱中的持续增殖，实现自解释的弱信号检测。
en_tdlr: C-Unseen leverages LLM reasoning and chain-of-thought to detect weak signals in dynamic temporal knowledge graphs by identifying and tracking the persistent proliferation of rare, semantically coherent subgraphs.
